query: INSERT INTO businesses.mailbox_check (business_id, member_id, mailbox_id, replaces, sent_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) ON CONFLICT (business_id, mailbox_id) DO UPDATE SET sent_at = $5, tries = 0, member_id = $2, replaces = $4 WHERE businesses.mailbox_check.verified_at IS NULL RETURNING id AS "id!"
